title: He turned the army back
note: The plague of Amwas, and a rule that holds the healthy out and the exposed in.

beats.text: A plague rule from the year 638

beats.sub: the caliph Umar is on the road there

beats.call: A town with plague in it
beats.callsub: Amwas, in Syria, in the year 638

beats.call: A line is drawn around it
beats.callsub: and it closes from both sides

beats.call: If you are outside, stay out
beats.callsub: do not walk into a place with plague

beats.call: If you are inside, stay in
beats.callsub: do not run out and take it with you

beats.text: So Umar turned his army around
beats.sub: he stopped at the edge and went back
